subject: Beirut, Lebanon
assessment: ANALYSIS: Beirut's port customs fragmentation, banking restrictions, utility grid instability, and bureaucratic delays generate severe friction for external deployment. RESOLUTION: UESP Protocol 33 activates digital infrastructure offsets, fiscal normalization corridors, and skill-corridor agreements to mitigate gridlock. DISPATCH: Creative (media/design) -> EU Cultural Grants; Technical (telecom/engineering) -> GCC Infrastructure Funds; Operational (logistics/labor) -> UN Recovery Programs; Intellectual (policy/analysis) -> World Bank Knowledge Hubs -> Global Avenues.
